source_row.stem: A facility installs ceiling-mounted lift systems in client rooms. These devices are intended to:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Intended for use only with bariatric clients, rather than for any client who is unable to safely assist with a transfer","B":"Understood to have little measurable effect on staff or client injury rates when used consistently","C":"Intended to fully replace the need for any staff assistance during a client transfer or repositioning","D":"Reduce manual lifting strain on staff while safely transferring or repositioning clients who cannot assist"}}
source_row.rationale: Ceiling-mounted lift systems reduce manual lifting strain on staff while safely transferring or repositioning clients who cannot assist, an evidence-based safe patient handling intervention.
source_row.source_name: ANA — Safe Patient Handling and Mobility Guidelines
